$comment: Merges arising from the residual audit sweep, not from a QA agent. Each is a duplicate the tree-wide audit rules could see but no single fragment owner could fix, because the two copies live in different fragments.

merges.why: Both nodes are named 'Nickel reforming catalyst' and both are leaf materials at medium confidence. The 70-petrochem copy is the one on the canonical hydrogen-from-SMR path and is the richer of the two (it carries the pre-1957 Topsoe SMR-180 detail and the multi-bed reformer tube geometry). Kept per CHECKLIST keep-rule 1. This is the last of the duplicate-name groups left by the QA pass.

Named 'Copper for the phthalocyanine centre', which rule 4 rejects as a name relative to its parent. It is also a path-local copy: metal.copper is the canonical published node, already at confidence high with eight children covering ore, concentrate, smelting, converting, anode, tankhouse, wire and foil. Kept per keep-rule 2, which prefers the canonical node over the contextual copy.

Child of the node merged above, and a second copy of the same ground: chalcopyrite is copper ore, which is what metal.copper.ore already publishes. Merged in the same pass rather than leaving a known duplicate one level down. Its two children, froth flotation and flash smelting, are adopted by metal.copper.ore; flotation is a documented terminal process in its own right and is listed in the audit's TERMINAL_PROCS exemptions.

Same furnace-black feedstock at the same level (both kind material): the domes copy describes itself as the same feedstock used in the resistors. Keep-rule 1 and 4: the passives copy is richer (sourced Carbon_black wiki, made-from residuum feed plus uses furnace edges) and already the recorded survivor of two earlier carbon-black merges, which named this domes copy as next to follow. Re-pointings (1): c64.keyboard-switches.domes.composition made-of carbon-black -> survivor. Content union: fold the grade/loading specificity (high-structure furnace black, percolation loading, responsive-vs-stiff) into the survivor note as unestablished. Facts union: none (loser 0 facts).
